columns.name: kit_number
columns.reason: Ambiguous: could be a modification kit already embodied or the parts kit issued for the replacement job.

columns.name: shift_team
columns.reason: Shift/crew assignment is standing operational context known at prediction time.

columns.name: inspection_method
columns.reason: The method used at the last inspection is recorded before any removal decision.

columns.name: hours_since_inspection
columns.reason: Running utilisation counter readable from the aircraft record now.

columns.name: zone_code
columns.reason: Static airframe zone in which the component is installed.

columns.name: fleet_avg_egt_margin
columns.reason: Fleet-level aggregate computed from history already on file.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.reason: Supplier of the installed part is fixed at installation.

columns.name: egt_margin_q2
columns.reason: Trailing engine trend window built from monitoring data already collected.

columns.name: engine_position
columns.reason: Installation position is static configuration data.

columns.name: line_station
columns.reason: Current line maintenance station is known operational context.

columns.name: aog_hours
columns.reason: Aircraft-on-ground hours accrue as a consequence of the unscheduled event, not before it.

columns.name: bleed_valve_cycles
columns.reason: Cumulative cycle counter maintained continuously in service.

columns.name: condition_monitor_index
columns.reason: Health index derived from monitoring data that exists before the removal.

columns.name: start_count_since_shop
columns.reason: Running counter since the last shop visit.

columns.name: cycles_since_overhaul
columns.reason: Running counter tracked continuously in service.

columns.name: oil_consumption_q1
columns.reason: Trailing consumption window from servicing data already recorded.

columns.name: shop_visit_delta_days
columns.reason: Reads as the interval to the shop visit, which only occurs after the component comes off.

columns.name: eng_order_class
columns.reason: Engineering order classification applicable to the component is normally on file beforehand.

columns.name: ata_chapter
columns.reason: Static system classification of the component.

columns.name: shelf_life_code
columns.reason: Part master attribute fixed before installation.

columns.name: torque_spec_rev
columns.reason: Revision of the torque specification in force is a published controlled document.

columns.name: ambient_temp_p50
columns.reason: Percentile summary of past operating environment already measured.

columns.name: replacement_part_cost_usd
columns.reason: A replacement part is only selected and costed once the removal has happened.

columns.name: part_series
columns.reason: Attribute of the part already installed.

columns.name: lease_flag
columns.reason: Ownership/lease status of the asset is known in advance.

columns.name: task_card_rev
columns.reason: Task card revision in force is a controlled document published ahead of the work.

columns.name: egt_margin_q4
columns.reason: Read as a further trailing EGT trend window; nothing given places it after the cutoff.

columns.name: tool_calibration_id
columns.reason: Could identify the tool used at the prior inspection or one used during the later removal job.

columns.name: manual_rev
columns.reason: Maintenance manual revision in force is published in advance.

columns.name: station_code
columns.reason: Station identifier is standing location metadata.

columns.name: crew_base
columns.reason: Base assignment is stable fleet metadata.

columns.name: config_mod_level
columns.reason: Modification standard is recorded at build or embodiment, before this prediction.

columns.name: storage_class
columns.reason: Part handling/storage classification is master data.

columns.name: vibration_exceed_flag
columns.reason: Exceedance flag comes from in-service monitoring before removal; predictive but not future.

columns.name: n2_vib_p90
columns.reason: Percentile of vibration data already recorded in service.

columns.name: hangar_bay
columns.reason: Treated as current facility location metadata rather than a record written by the removal job.

columns.name: oil_debris_flag
columns.reason: Debris detection is a monitoring signal raised before the component is removed.

columns.name: egt_margin_q3
columns.reason: Trailing EGT trend window from data already collected.

columns.name: planner_group
columns.reason: Owning planning organisation is standing metadata.

columns.name: log_page_prefix
columns.reason: Prefix follows a fixed tech-log convention known when the defect is logged.

columns.name: access_panel_code
columns.reason: Static airframe access location for that component.

columns.name: tail_suffix
columns.reason: Part of the aircraft registration, fixed well before prediction.

columns.name: consumable_lot
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether it is the lot of an already-fitted consumable or one drawn during the removal job.

columns.name: oil_consumption_q2
columns.reason: Trailing consumption window from servicing data already recorded.

columns.name: sector_length_hr_q1
columns.reason: Historical operating profile aggregate computed from completed flights.

columns.name: teardown_finding_score
columns.reason: Teardown findings only exist after the component has been removed and stripped.

columns.name: egt_margin_q1
columns.reason: Trailing EGT trend window from monitoring data already collected.
